question: Who should I approach for funding for my startup?
answer: For funding for your startup, you should approach GUIITAR Council, which is dedicated to promoting and supporting innovation and startups. You can contact Mr. Kirankumar Parmar, Sr. Manager, at email guiitar@gsfcuniversity.ac.in or mobile 09313262712. [1][2]

citations.text:
GUIITAR Council | CONTACT US
GUIITAR Council GU Incubation Innovation Technology and Applied Research (GUIITAR) Council has been established by GSFC University (GSFCU) at Vadodara, dedicated to promoting and supporting creativity, innovation and the spirit of enterprise among young minds and innovators. GUIITAR Council is registered under section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013. ​ GUIITAR Council is committed to nurturing and developing startups through shared resources, Infrastructure, cutting-edge laboratories, tailored mentorship, extended networking and other standard services such as Co-working space, Equipment, Business support, and Intellectual Property Protection. ​ VISION To nurture young minds by providing a platform to explore and showcase their potential, along with the generation of high added value, with a focus on innovation as well as marketing of technologies for the betterment of the Scientific, Engineering, Science & Management Communities and the Society. MISSION To produce success stories in innovations and startups that will make the young minds confident, freestanding and financially viable. ​ OBJECTIVES To establish, manage and operate a business incubator. To promote entrepreneurship and to incubate individuals, groups of individuals, and convert their efforts into enterprises by collaborating with similar institutions. To catalyse the process of incubation. To manage technology, applied research, knowledge networks, and human resource development. To offer mentoring services to help with enterprise growth. To encourage new ventures for the benefit of society and to undertake all related activities to achieve the GUIITAR Council's vision. ​ THRUST AREA Agriculture and allied fields Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Biotechnology Clean-Tech Cyber Security Energy Environmental Challenges & Solutions Healthcare Information & Communication Technology (ICT) Internet of Things (IoT) Manufacturing Services Water (Drinking Water, Wastewater and Storm Water Utilities)

question: What is their research background?
answer: Ms. Shweta N Rajput's research background includes Cloud Computing and Computer Vision, with a focus on developing security frameworks for virtual machine migration and exploring artificial intelligence and data science. [1][2]

Shweta N Rajput
← Back to Faculty List Shweta N Rajput PhD Scholar, NIT Surat Email: shweta.rajput@gsfcuniversity.ac.in Ms. Shweta Rajput is currently working as Assistant Professor and Head of the Departments of Computer Science & Engineering and Computer Applications at GSFC University, Vadodara. She has over 16 years of teaching experience and has previously worked at BITS Edu Campus,Vadodara, HJD Institute of Technical Education and Research, Kutchh, and Engineering College, Tuwa. She holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering from L.D. College of Engineering, Ahmedabad and is currently pursuing her Ph.D. at Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat. Her research interests include Cloud Computing and Computer Vision. Along with teaching, she is actively involved in mentoring students, coordinating academic activities, and leading departmental initiatives. She enjoys exploring new teaching methods, organizing hands-on tech events, and helping students build skills that match industry needs. Passionate about education and innovation, Ms. Rajput continues to contribute to making computer science learning more engaging, practical, and future-ready. The festival celebrates creativity, innovation, collaboration, and the vibrant spirit of campus life. Events like Ananta provide a unique opportunity to interact with peers from different programs, showcase talents, learn new ideas, and create memorable experiences beyond the classroom. Please note that *attendance during these days is mandatory*, and attendance will be *mapped between the regular academic schedule and the Ananta events taking place during the respective time slots*.
